Good Morning,

Anthony's recommendations are good ones if you already have a good background in Survival Analysis.  If you are like me and need more information that is not Rattle specific I found the following useful:

Youtube video that uses RStudio: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qt2ufTPCWwI

Two Survival Analysis books that use R:
http://www.amazon.com/Event-History-Analysis-Chapman-Hall/dp/1439831645/ref=sr_1_1?s=books&ie=UTF8&qid=1367962234&sr=1-1&keywords=Event+History+Analysis+With+R
http://www.amazon.com/Introducing-Survival-Event-History-Analysis/dp/1848601026/ref=sr_1_1?s=books&ie=UTF8&qid=1367961915&sr=1-1&keywords=Introducing+Survival+and+Event+History+Analysis

There is also a recent Revolution Analytics video on this subject that has some good ideas:
http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/2013/07/using-survival-models-for-marketing-attribution.html
